en-US.name: ShiftWeave Nursing Handoff
en-US.shortDescription: Ambient ICU nursing shift handoff, task tracking, and workflow recovery companion.
en-US.fullDescription:
ShiftWeave is a protocol-native ambient assistant for ICU and ward nurses.

Key Capabilities:
- Real-time discovery of assigned clinical and operational tasks
- Grounded SBAR handoff synthesis between outgoing and incoming nurses
- Cross-system discrepancy detection (EHR orders vs nursing bedside notes)
- Zero-loss checkpointing & recovery from workflow interruptions
- Zero autonomous diagnoses or order modifications (strict nursing boundary)
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask ShiftWeave what tasks Seema left unresolved
Alexa, ask ShiftWeave for my shift handoff summary
Alexa, ask ShiftWeave to check ICU room 305
